tools.name: ai_chat
tools.description: Send a prompt, get an answer from Meta's Llama 4 Scout (17B active, 16 experts), with an optional system prompt, up to 1,024 output tokens and adjustable temperature. Fast and cheap. Use for drafting, reasoning steps, Q&A and any quick LLM call without an AI provider account; other open models by na

tools.name: ai_chat_large
tools.description: Send a prompt, get an answer from a larger open model: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct (default) or OpenAI gpt-oss-120b, with an optional system prompt, up to 1,024 output tokens and adjustable temperature. Same call as /ai/chat with a stronger model. Use when the 8B model is not enough: reasoning, drafting

tools.name: ai_embed
tools.description: A 1,024-dimension embedding vector for up to 4,000 characters of text in 100+ languages, from BAAI's BGE-M3. Use for semantic search, RAG retrieval, clustering and deduplication. Example: text=pay-per-call APIs for AI agents. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; fa

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe speech from an audio file at a public URL using Whisper large-v3-turbo. Returns the transcript text, detected language, duration and word count. Accepts common formats such as MP3, WAV, M4A and OGG up to 5 MB. Use for voice notes, podcast clips, meeting snippets and voice messages. Exampl

tools.name: ai_speech
tools.description: Turn up to 1,000 characters of text into natural speech as an audio file (base64, with its content type), in English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Japanese or Korean, with MeloTTS. Use for voice replies, audio notes, accessibility and phone or chat bots. Example: text=Your payment was received. Thank y

tools.name: image
tools.description: Text-to-image generation with FLUX.1 schnell. Send a prompt, get a 1024x1024 JPEG back as base64 in a few seconds. Use for illustrations, thumbnails, mockups, avatars and social media images. Optional steps parameter (1-8, default 4) trades speed for detail. Example: prompt=a lighthouse on a cliff a

tools.name: describe
tools.description: Vision model for an image at a public URL: get a detailed description including any visible text, or pass a question to ask something specific about the image. Accepts PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF up to 3 MB. Use for alt text, OCR-style reading of screenshots, chart reading and content checks. Price $0.0

tools.name: ai_summarize_text
tools.description: Summarize up to 12,000 characters of text you send into a few sentences plus bullet key points. Use for long emails, documents, transcripts and tool outputs (for a web page by URL, use /summarize). Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or co

tools.name: ai_translate
tools.description: Translate text between about 100 languages with Meta's M2M100 1.2B model. Give the target language as an ISO code such as en, sv, de, fr, es, zh or ja; the source language is optional. Use to localise messages and documents. Example: text=Payment received, thank you!, to=sv. Price $0.01/call via x40

tools.name: ai_extract_json
tools.description: Pull named fields out of unstructured text (emails, invoices, listings, bios) and get them back as a JSON object, with null for anything not present. Use to turn messy text into structured data for an agent. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. R

tools.name: ai_answer
tools.description: Answer a question from the live web in one call: a Brave web search, the top result pages read, and an answer written by Llama 4 Scout from those sources only, with inline [n] citations and the source list (title, URL). Says so when the sources do not answer it. Results are for the caller's immediat

tools.name: ai_fact_check
tools.description: Check a claim against the live web in one call: a Brave search, the top pages read, and a verdict from Llama 4 Scout using those sources only (supported, contradicted, mixed or unverified) with a short explanation, [n] citations and the sources. A model's reading of a few search results, not an edit

tools.name: ai_rerank
tools.description: Order up to 50 documents by how well each answers a query, with a relevance score from 0 to 1 (BAAI bge-reranker-base, a cross-encoder). Send documents as a JSON array or one per line; each is read up to 2,000 characters, 40,000 in all. Returns the original index, score and text, best first; top_n k

tools.name: ai_moderation
tools.description: Classify a text as safe or unsafe with Meta's Llama Guard 3 and name the hazard categories it falls into (violent and non-violent crimes, sexual content, child exploitation, hate, self-harm, weapons, privacy, defamation, elections and others; 14 in all). Up to 8,000 characters. Also available in the

tools.name: ai_model_qwen3_30b
tools.description: Chat with Alibaba's Qwen3 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model (Apache 2.0) through one paid HTTP call: send a prompt and an optional system prompt, get the answer, up to 1,024 output tokens; its reasoning is removed from the answer. Also reachable as model "qwen3-30b" on the OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/

tools.name: ai_model_gpt_oss_20b
tools.description: Chat with OpenAI's open-weight gpt-oss-20b reasoning model (Apache 2.0) through one paid HTTP call: send a prompt and an optional system prompt, get the answer, up to 1,024 output tokens. Also reachable as model "gpt-oss-20b" on the OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions. No account or provider key.

tools.name: ai_model_gpt_oss_120b
tools.description: Chat with OpenAI's open-weight gpt-oss-120b reasoning model (Apache 2.0) through one paid HTTP call: send a prompt and an optional system prompt, get the answer, up to 1,024 output tokens. tools.name: ai_model_deepseek_r1
tools.description: Chat with DeepSeek's R1 reasoning model distilled into Qwen 32B (MIT) through one paid HTTP call: send a prompt and an optional system prompt, get the answer, up to 2,048 output tokens; its reasoning is removed from the answer. Also reachable as model "deepseek-r1" on the OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/

tools.description: Positive or negative sentiment of English text with a confidence score, from a DistilBERT model fine-tuned on SST-2. Use to triage reviews, support messages, social posts and replies. Example: text=The checkout was fast and support answered within minutes.. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card k

Use to polish emails, replies, product copy and messages. Example: text=hey, cant make it tmrw, can we move to thu?. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card

tools.description: A structured Markdown outline (headings and bullet points) of a text you send, or a suggested outline for a topic. Use to plan articles, reports, talks and documentation. Example: text=How small businesses can accept stablecoin payments. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ai_chat, ai_chat_large, describe, ai_extract_json, ai_answer, ai_model_qwen3_30b, ai_model_gpt_oss_20b, ai_model_gpt_oss_120b, ai_model_mistral_small, ai_model_qwen_coder, ai_model_deepseek_r1, ai_classify · Private data: ai_chat, ai_chat_large, transcribe, ai_speech, ai_summarize_text, ai_translate, ai_rerank, ai_model_qwen3_30b, ai_model_gpt_oss_20b, ai_model_gpt_oss_120b, ai_model_mistral_small, ai_model_qwen_coder, ai_model_deepseek_r1 · Public sink: ai_chat, ai_chat_large, image, ai_summarize_text, ai_rerank, ai_model_qwen3_30b, ai_model_gpt_oss_20b, ai_model_gpt_oss_120b, ai_model_mistral_small, ai_model_qwen_coder, ai_model_deepseek_r1, ai_outline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ai_chat, ai_chat_large, describe, ai_extract_json, ai_answer, ai_model_qwen3_30b, ai_model_gpt_oss_20b, ai_model_gpt_oss_120b, ai_model_mistral_small, ai_model_qwen_coder, ai_model_deepseek_r1, ai_classify · Private data: ai_chat, ai_chat_large, transcribe, ai_speech, ai_summarize_text, ai_translate, ai_rerank, ai_model_qwen3_30b, ai_model_gpt_oss_20b, ai_model_gpt_oss_120b, ai_model_mistral_small, ai_model_qwen_coder, ai_model_deepseek_r1 · Public sink: ai_chat, ai_chat_large, image, ai_summarize_text, ai_rerank, ai_model_qwen3_30b, ai_model_gpt_oss_20b, ai_model_gpt_oss_120b, ai_model_mistral_small, ai_model_qwen_coder, ai_model_deepseek_r1, ai_outline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
